name: Hushim
title: Son of Dan
summary: Hushim (also known as Shuham) was the only named son of Dan, who was the son of Jacob and Bilhah. He is regarded as the patriarch of the Hushimite clan among the Danites. Although little is written about him personally, he played an important role as the founder of one of the sub-clans in the tribe of Dan.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among Jacob's descendants who went to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Hushim is listed as a son of Dan among the seventy people in Jacob's household who went down to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Recorded in Benjamin's genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Hushim is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as part of Israel's tribal history.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Dan in the census
keyEvents.description: In the second census on the plains of Moab, Hushim's descendants are referred to as the Shuhamites, the only clan within the tribe of Dan.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Family Listed
keyEvents.description: As part of the complete list of Jacob's sons and grandsons, Hushim represents Dan's line in the genealogy of the patriarchs.

keyEvents.title: The Inheritance of the Tribe of Dan
keyEvents.description: Hushim's descendants, as part of the tribe of Dan, received their inheritance in the promised land during the division of the land.
